purpose: One-time, in batches: build Henry's knowledge of past meetups from the YouTube channel (15 streams, 2026-05-20 to 2026-10-15) and Martin's decks. Each run handles at most 4 streams that are not done yet.

inputs.what: mcp__transcribe__transcribe_list_channel (default channel, with dates) and mcp__transcribe__transcribe_list_done (done = transcript with knowledge_doc)

steps.do: List the streams and the done transcripts; pick at most 4 streams that are not done yet (oldest first); count the streams left after this batch (remaining_count)

For each picked stream: transcribe_video {url, store:true} (transcript and its Knowledge document in one call). Never paste transcript text into a document yourself. status no_speech = silent: skip it, it counts as done

For each stored stream: read it with transcribe_read (part 1..n as needed) and write ONE summary document (at most 400 words: topics, Martin's explanations, audience questions) in Knowledge 'Meetup transcripts', linked to the transcript document; remember recurring topics in the brain
Create or update the topic index document (one line per meetup: date, topics, document links)
Put remaining_count in the last issue comment and in the run report lessons. If remaining_count > 0, block the issue with 'continue: <n> left' (Martin or Lane C re-runs !run p7-backfill)

outputs: one transcript document + one summary document per past meetup (Knowledge 'Meetup transcripts')
brain memories: recurring topics, Martin's style, audience questions
topic index document (in the run that finishes the backfill)

escalation.when: a deck has no matching stream
streams remain after this run: the issue is blocked 'continue: <n> left'
